headline: ConocoPhillips to Sell Norwegian Business to Vår Energi for $4.4 Billion
summary: ConocoPhillips entered a definitive agreement to sell its Norway business and a 40.25% stake in the UK Teesside oil terminal to Norway-based Vår Energi for $4.425 billion.
why: ConocoPhillips is a major US international oil producer, while Vår Energi is a top independent upstream company operating on the Norwegian continental shelf.

impacts.name: Vår Energi
impacts.why: Vår Energi is buying ConocoPhillips's Norwegian business and UK terminal stake for $4.425 billion.
